rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when food is chopped into very small pieces.

example.english: The onion should be finely chopped so the soup will be fragrant.
example.traditional: 洋蔥切得好碎啲，煮湯先夠香。
example.jyutping: joeng4 cung1 cit3 dak1 hou2 seoi3 di1 zyu2 tong1 sin1 gau3 hoeng1

rows.note: Use this instead when the pieces are specifically sliced into thin sheets or strips rather than chopped small.

example.english: The ham is finely sliced, so it is perfect for sandwiches.
example.traditional: 火腿切得好薄，夾三文治最啱。
example.jyutping: fo2 teoi2 cit3 dak1 hou2 bok6 gaap3 saam1 man4 zi6 zeoi3 ngaam1
